title: Godot (Ranging from 4.6 to 4.7.1) Crashing at macOS Monterey MBP 2015
body:
### Tested versions

Godot Ranging to 4.6 to 4.7.1 - Stable

### System information

macOS Monterey - Godot 4.7.1 - Mobile Shader - Intel Iris 6100

### Issue description

Hi, i am a fellow game developer, and i want to report a bug where godot won't launch at macbook pro 2015. The problem is, It keeps crashing when i create a project. and when i use godot (versions ranging from 4.0 to 4.5.2), it doesn't crash. What seems to be the problem?

### Steps to reproduce
